description: This file defines a REST API class for managing annotation layers in the Superset application, including endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, and bulk deleting annotation layers, with associated schemas, commands, and error handling.

classes.name: AnnotationLayerRestApi
classes.description: REST API class for managing annotation layers, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and bulk delete, with integrated logging, permissions, and schema validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a specific annotation layer by primary key, with error handling for not found and integrity errors.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new annotation layer, validating input schema and handling creation errors.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing annotation layer identified by primary key, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Handles bulk deletion of annotation layers based on provided IDs, with error handling for not found and integrity errors.
